name: Clear aligners (Invisalign-style)
summary: How expats evaluate clear aligner treatment in Singapore — dentist vs orthodontist pathways, refinement rounds, retainer plans, and dental rider limits.
body:
Clear aligners move teeth with sequential trays. Case complexity decides whether a general dentist or orthodontist should lead. Refinement rounds and retainers are where quotes quietly expand.

## Decision points
- Mild crowding vs bite issues needing braces instead
- Dentist vs orthodontist provider choice
- Attachment / IPR expectations
- Refinement rounds included in package
- Retainer type and replacement costs

Compliance hours matter — trays only work when worn.

## How to choose
Prefer providers who show a digital treatment plan and state refinement caps in writing. Ask who handles mid-treatment emergencies if you travel. Confirm dental rider exclusions for elective orthodontics.

## Practical tip
Calendar tray-change days on your phone with a photo of the current bag. Lost trays mid-trip are a common expensive scramble.
